item.title: github: Stateless GitHub App installation tokens rolled out
item.description:
GitHub has completed the staged rollout of the stateless GitHub App installation token format. By default, newly minted installation tokens now use the new format.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Security reviews now available in the GitHub Copilot app
item.description:
GitHub Copilot app now supports running security reviews on in-flight code changes with the /security-review slash command. The feature is available in public preview.

  • Source: GitHub
